# Written by Anyserve. Supabase's API routes, after its docker/volumes/api/kong.yml.
_format_version: '2.1'
_transform: true
consumers:
  - username: anon
    keyauth_credentials:
      - key: {{jwt (sha256 .Settings.jwt_seed) "anon"}}
  - username: service_role
    keyauth_credentials:
      - key: {{jwt (sha256 .Settings.jwt_seed) "service_role"}}
acls:
  - consumer: anon
    group: anon
  - consumer: service_role
    group: admin
services:
  - name: auth-v1-open
    url: http://auth:9999/verify
    routes: [{ name: auth-v1-open, strip_path: true, paths: [/auth/v1/verify] }]
    plugins: [{ name: cors }]
  - name: auth-v1-open-callback
    url: http://auth:9999/callback
    routes: [{ name: auth-v1-open-callback, strip_path: true, paths: [/auth/v1/callback] }]
    plugins: [{ name: cors }]
  - name: auth-v1-open-authorize
    url: http://auth:9999/authorize
    routes: [{ name: auth-v1-open-authorize, strip_path: true, paths: [/auth/v1/authorize] }]
    plugins: [{ name: cors }]
  - name: auth-v1
    url: http://auth:9999/
    routes: [{ name: auth-v1-all, strip_path: true, paths: [/auth/v1/] }]
    plugins:
      - name: cors
      - { name: key-auth, config: { hide_credentials: false } }
      - { name: acl, config: { hide_groups_header: true, allow: [admin, anon] } }
  - name: rest-v1
    url: http://rest:3000/
    routes: [{ name: rest-v1-all, strip_path: true, paths: [/rest/v1/] }]
    plugins:
      - name: cors
      - { name: key-auth, config: { hide_credentials: true } }
      - { name: acl, config: { hide_groups_header: true, allow: [admin, anon] } }
  - name: graphql-v1
    url: http://rest:3000/rpc/graphql
    routes: [{ name: graphql-v1-all, strip_path: true, paths: [/graphql/v1] }]
    plugins:
      - name: cors
      - { name: key-auth, config: { hide_credentials: true } }
      - { name: request-transformer, config: { add: { headers: ["Content-Profile:graphql_public"] } } }
      - { name: acl, config: { hide_groups_header: true, allow: [admin, anon] } }
  # Realtime picks its tenant from the host name: realtime-dev.
  - name: realtime-v1-ws
    url: http://realtime-dev:4000/socket
    protocol: ws
    routes: [{ name: realtime-v1-ws, strip_path: true, paths: [/realtime/v1/] }]
    plugins:
      - name: cors
      - { name: key-auth, config: { hide_credentials: false } }
      - { name: acl, config: { hide_groups_header: true, allow: [admin, anon] } }
  - name: realtime-v1-rest
    url: http://realtime-dev:4000/api
    protocol: http
    routes: [{ name: realtime-v1-rest, strip_path: true, paths: [/realtime/v1/api] }]
    plugins:
      - name: cors
      - { name: key-auth, config: { hide_credentials: false } }
      - { name: acl, config: { hide_groups_header: true, allow: [admin, anon] } }
  - name: storage-v1
    url: http://storage:5000/
    routes: [{ name: storage-v1-all, strip_path: true, paths: [/storage/v1/] }]
    plugins: [{ name: cors }]

notes: Needs Docker with the Compose plugin, about 3 GB of images and 2 GB of memory.

Two addresses: the app (port http) and its API (port api). Behind an HTTPS proxy, point https://chat.example.com at http and https://db.chat.example.com at api, then set url and api_url to those. Both listen on 127.0.0.1 only; --expose http --expose api opens them to your network.
The admin account is created on every start if it's missing; `anyserve config <name> --show-secrets` shows its password. Changing admin_password later doesn't change an existing account's password.
Never change jwt_seed or postgres_password after the first start.
Without a mail server, new addresses count as confirmed and invitations are links you share yourself. Voice (LiveKit), bots, push notifications and the Discord bridge aren't set up.
Harmony is AGPL-3.0 with attribution and trademark terms; this runs its unmodified images. An unofficial package, not endorsed by the Harmony project.

settings.prompt: Remote console password (leave empty to generate one)

files.template:
// Your own Quake 4 server settings. Anyserve never changes this file.
set si_warmup 1
set si_fragLimit 25
set si_timeLimit 15

notes: Bring your own game data. The archive holds the 1.4.2 server and patch paks, but not the base game's q4base/pak001.pk4 to pak012.pk4, which aren't redistributable. Copy those from your own copy of Quake 4 (Steam app 2210) into q4base, or the server stops with "Couldn't load scripts/main.script".
The server crashes on start if its folder path is very long (over about 100 characters); the default location is fine.
A 32-bit server. On 64-bit Debian or Ubuntu it needs the 32-bit C library (sudo apt install libc6-i386).
